name: price_bar
description: Daily OHLCV bars for pool members and reference series (benchmarks, VIX, VIX3M).

columns.name: pool
columns.description: Pool, or 'reference' for benchmarks and indices.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Session date in the market's local calendar (UTC date for crypto).

columns.name: adj_close
columns.description: Close adjusted for splits and dividends; used for returns.

columns.name: volume
columns.description: Shares (equities) or units (crypto); null for indices without volume.

columns.name: ingested_at
columns.description: UTC time the row was fetched.
